mainRoof.notes: Two parallel gable roofs with ridges along the front: the main body higher, the garage lower (step down at the junction, gable ends on left and right). Low-slope shed porch roofs tucked under the main eaves at front and rear. No dormers, no cross gables. Pitch is not printed; ~37 deg (about 9:12) measured off the left elevation.

features.where: front porch (main body only) and rear porch (full width of main body), low-slope shed roofs
4 timber posts on the front porch, 4 on the rear porch
horizontal-bar railing between the front porch posts (render only; not drawn on the elevation)
none drawn (interior fireplace on the left wall has no visible chimney)

palette.walls: black / charcoal horizontal lap siding with natural cedar-coloured porch posts and a wood-tone garage door; black window frames

uncertain: Entrance door centre is at ~0.31 of the full front width, i.e. just inside the LEFT third, close to the LEFT/CENTRE boundary (it is central within the main body).
The two front windows are triple units with transoms, about 2.1-2.3 m wide on the plan: counted as WINDOW (below the ~2.5 m threshold), but close to it.

REAR, seen from outside left to right: garage window (double slider), utility door, bedroom 1 window, small high bathroom window, bedroom 2 window. The garage rear window is drawn on the rear elevation but NOT on the floor plan.
LEFT facade: two tall narrow windows (flanking the fireplace), at CENTRE and RIGHT thirds (towards the front).
RIGHT facade: a single glazed side door into the garage near the rear end (RIGHT third as seen from outside); no windows. The taller main-house gable shows behind the garage gable.
Building height is not printed; scaled off the left elevation the ridge is roughly 6.7 m above ground (estimate only).
Garage door is one double-width door (16' x 8' roll-up), counted as 1.
confidence: HIGH - four labelled orthographic elevations and a dimensioned plan agree with each other and with the render; only the garage rear window differs between plan and elevation.
